name: mod.yagens_attributes.reach

capacity.description: Mod capacity used at level 0 and additional capacity per level. Total capacity cost is base + per_level * level.

max_level_description: Maximum inclusive Mod level. Level 0 is a usable Mod and every entry scales with (level + 1).

entries.description: Flat initial addition at level 0, before multipliers. Seconds for combo duration, blocks for melee range; scales with (level + 1).
